items.description:
##Yesterday##

Early showers soon clearing to leave a mostly dry & bright day with sunny spells. Rain arriving this evening, turning heavier overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 13°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

7-12


##Wind Speed##

10


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 5-10, backing S or SE this evening. Becoming SE 20-25, locally 25-30, overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times tonight. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong wind overnight. Risk of minor coastal overtopping around time of high tide (1:30am).
